svg.aria-label: Two scatter plots over the ten benchmark tables. Left: Starfold recovery minus the default recovery against the mean class size over the resolution scale; right: the Spearman correlation of the trial score with recovery. Development tables as circles, held-out tables as squares; a dashed line marks a group of the resolution scale.
